study: Pilot 0 Localization B0: correction-signal manipulation validation
scope: Validate that signal identity produces the intended ordered confidence-state update; B0 does not test final correctness, H1, B, or C.

sampling.eligibility: retain only initially-wrong frozen prestates after the unchanged Pilot 0 pre-treatment procedure

design.matched_rng: within each frozen prestate and replicate index, E0/EU/EV use the same generation seed

signals.E0: Signal status: No new information is available about whether your previous answer is correct.
signals.EU: Signal status: There is unverified reason to doubt whether your previous answer is correct.
signals.EV: Signal status: It has been verified that your previous answer is incorrect.

measurement.p_pre: reuse the already-recorded frozen pre-treatment P(correct); never regenerate baseline confidence inside B0
measurement.p_post: reported probability after signal that the unchanged previous answer is correct, measured before any reconsideration or revision

analysis.replicate_collapse: average the two P_post values within each signal before across-block analysis
analysis.pass_rule: PASS only if mean(M_E0-M_EU) > 0 and mean(M_EU-M_EV) > 0 and the 95% block-bootstrap lower bounds for both adjacent contrasts are > 0.
analysis.unresolved_rule: UNRESOLVED if both adjacent mean contrasts are positive but either adjacent 95% bootstrap interval includes 0.
analysis.fail_order_rule: FAIL_ORDER if either adjacent mean contrast is <= 0.
analysis.non_circularity: final-answer correctness and moderation are not used to establish manipulation validity

interpretation.PASS: the E0/EU/EV informational contrast is behaviorally instantiated; this does not support B or H1
interpretation.UNRESOLVED: signal ordering is directionally present but not cleanly separated; B remains unresolved and B1 does not run
interpretation.FAIL_ORDER: the intended signal ordering is not behaviorally instantiated; repair signal manipulation only; C gains no authority
